name: near-chunk-validation-d0-stark

restrictions.text: protocol_version = 86 (nearcore 2.13.4), mainnet runtime parameters RuntimeConfigStore::new(None).get_config(86)
every block of the claim's chain segment is in epoch_id; one epoch record; no epoch start in the segment
the epoch's shard layout is ShardLayout V2 or V3 with 1..=64 shards
block headers V6; chunk header inners V4/V5
no validator-account update and no dynamic-resharding split check for any applied block
the last new chunk of the shard is not the genesis chunk
no transaction validity flags (no transactions)
the chain segment has at most 32 blocks
the chunk gas_limit in the last-chunk block's slot of the validated shard is at most 10^15 gas (mainnet genesis 1000 Tgas; nearcore never changes a chunk gas limit after genesis) [A1]
the shard's congestion info in the last-chunk block has zero delayed gas, buffered gas and receipt bytes
the witness has no transactions and no new_transactions
no contract code accompanies the witness
state witness <= 8 MiB and the main transition's base_state <= 3,000,000 bytes
every receipt in every source_receipt_proofs entry (incl. overridden duplicate keys) has the D0 receipt shape
every receipt of every used source receipt proof routes, under the epoch's shard layout, to the validated shard (true of every honest single-epoch witness) [A2]
every applied receipt: ReceiptEnum::Action, one Transfer action, no data dependencies, ED25519/SECP256K1 signer key, named receiver
a gas refund (system predecessor, signer = receiver) finds no access key or a FullAccess key
every applied receipt succeeds (receiver exists as AccountV1, no overflow, storage stake covered)
no incoming receipt is delayed by the compute limit
delayed-receipt queue, outgoing buffers and promise-yield queue are empty in the pre-state
every generated receipt is forwarded (never buffered)
every BandwidthSchedulerState value read (main and implicit pre-states) is absent or V1 listing exactly the layout's n^2 links in sender-major order (what update_scheduler_state writes) [Canon0f]

unfoldBytes <= B0 = 3,000,000: the bytes of every partial trie the relation builds, unfolded per read-path copy, plus the post-write path copies, summed over all transitions (NearSpecV3.unfoldBytes) [A7]
applied receipt ids are pairwise distinct

hardware_profile.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (local operator host; 8 vCPUs pinned per run)

classes.description: D0 chunks with no incoming receipt and no implicit transition: context authentication (hash-linked segment, chunk_headers_root), empty main transition, bandwidth scheduler, congestion info and the Reed-Solomon encoded merkle root

D0 chunks applying >= 1 incoming cross-shard Transfer receipt (source receipt proofs, ChaCha20 shuffle, Runtime::apply over the partial trie, refunds, outcome and outgoing-receipts roots), no implicit transition
D0 chunks after >= 1 missing chunk of the shard (implicit transitions: missing-chunk applies with the bandwidth scheduler), with or without incoming receipts; chains with 25% chunk skips
